original.verbatim:
- The designer of a coil needs to determine the length of the iron core.
- Mathematics used to calculate core length is complex.
- If the core is too long, the primary magnetizing current will be too large.
- If the core is too short, secondary coils would need to be too large in diameter to be efficient.
- A certain core length will give the best results.
- Experts who had studied this matter for their entire lives were consulted in determining the core length and other dimensions of the transformer for a specific use case.
